newsitem.title: USA: Calif voters OK two large bonds on state ballot.
newsitem.headline: Calif voters OK two large bonds on state ballot.

text.p: California voters approved two large statewide bond measures to fund water projects and aid for veterans, according to election returns.

Proposition 204 provides for a bond issue of $995 million to ensure safe drinking water, increase water supplies, clean up pollution in rivers and protect wildlife. It was approved by a vote of 62.7 percent to 37.3 percent with 80 percent of precincts reporting, election officials said.

Proposition 206 provides for a bond issue of $400 million to provide farm and home aid for California veterans. It was approved by a vote of 53.8 percent to 46.2 percent with 80 percent of precincts reporting, officials said.

Voters rejected proposition 205, a jail bond measure that would have provided for a bond issue of $700 million to provide funds for construction, renovation and replacement of local juvenile and adult correctional facilities.
